name: Parameterized execution key must dominate stateful grouping

payload.description: A stateful operator is moved below a parameterized executor; admission must prove that parameter partitions cannot split one semantic state group.
positive_signal: guard checks only column occurrence or syntactic subset
state key is an expression or equivalence class not functionally determined by parameter key
execution can create multiple parameter tasks
required_gates: forced parameterized and non-parameterized plan identities
negative_screens: exact group key contains parameter key as an independent grouping item
state is globally shared across all parameter tasks

provenance.source: PR 66217 review P1 plus current execution RED

name: IndexJoin parameter tasks must not split expression aggregation groups

payload.p_check: checkIndexJoinInnerTaskWithAgg sees inner key a in the columns extracted from GROUP BY a+b.
payload.q_claim: that syntactic membership makes inner aggregation safe under per-a IndexJoin tasks.
payload.failure: rows (1,1025) and (1025,1) share group 1026 but are aggregated in separate lookup tasks, producing partial sums 10 and 20 instead of global sum 30.

required_observations: cross-task runtime count greater than one
payload.red: IndexJoin returns two partial aggregation rows while HashJoin returns one global aggregation row
payload.green: one IndexJoin task sees all equivalent-group rows and happens to match HashJoin
payload.invalid: hint ignored, reference also uses IndexJoin, or runtime task count is not observed

name: Equivalent expression group split across lookup keys

payload.query_shape: outer JOIN (SELECT a,a+b,SUM(v) FROM inner GROUP BY a+b) on outer.k=a

steps: construct two different parameter keys with the same semantic state key
place the keys across a chunk/task boundary
assert runtime task count and compare ordered rows
payload.stop: do not enumerate expressions after the same dominance root is proven
